products.description: Manufactured ruggedized servers and avionics mission computers designed for harsh environments and SWaP-constrained platforms, supporting real-time data processing and mission-critical applications in aerospace and defense.

products.name: Secure Processing and Embedded Security Solutions
products.description: Security engineering products and embedded security solutions, including secure boot, key management, attack countermeasures, and secure microelectronics, designed to protect critical program information and meet DoD security requirements.

products.name: Data and Video Recording, Storage, and Encryption Systems
products.description: Systems for data and video recording, storage, and encryption, providing secure, high-throughput management of mission data and mitigating cyber vulnerabilities for defense and aerospace platforms.

products.name: Rugged Display Systems and Human-Machine Interface Products
products.description: Manufactured rugged display systems and technologies that integrate human and machine interfaces, including active matrix liquid crystal display systems, to support mission execution and decision-making in challenging environments.

products.name: Professional Services and Systems Integration
products.description: Professional services including systems integration, rapid deployment, and application porting for defense prime contractors, leveraging open architecture and modular product sets to reduce risk and development cycles.

products.name: Oil and Natural Gas Production
products.description: Granite Ridge invests in and participates in the development and production of oil and natural gas wells across multiple U.S. basins, primarily through operated partnerships and non-operated working interests. Production is physically extracted from wells and sold to market via third-party operators, requiring significant capital investment and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Private Debt and Equity Investments
products.description: Investing in the debt and equity securities of small and middle market companies, primarily through private transactions. Investments include bonds, subordinated debt, convertible debt, preferred and common stock, and securities with warrants. These are negotiated directly and require significant financial capital and due diligence.

products.name: Management Assistance to Portfolio Companies
products.description: Providing significant managerial assistance, guidance, and board representation to portfolio companies as part of the investment process. This service is delivered through in-person involvement and strategic advisory, often required by regulation for business development companies.

products.name: Temporary Investments
products.description: Investing available funds in short-term, interest-bearing instruments such as bank accounts, money market mutual funds, U.S. Treasury securities, certificates of deposit, and commercial paper. These are digital or paper-based financial products used for liquidity management.

products.name: Press Release Distribution
products.description: A digital service providing comprehensive news dissemination and media outreach for private and public companies, leveraging advanced technology for self-publishing, AI-assisted creation, editorial review, and analytics, delivered via an integrated online platform.

products.name: Media Database, Pitching, and Monitoring Suite
products.description: A digital suite combining a curated media database of active journalists, AI-assisted media pitching tools, and comprehensive media monitoring across print, broadcast, web, and social media, delivered through a unified online platform.

products.name: Media Room Solutions
products.description: A digital newsroom platform providing custom newsroom page builders, brand asset management, and contact management, available as an add-on or stand-alone product for managing media assets and outreach.

products.name: Press Release Optimizer (PRO)
products.description: An automated digital solution for optimizing media and marketing communications, using AI to enhance content creation, targeting, and timing for increased media visibility and brand awareness, available as an add-on to platform subscriptions.

products.name: Webcasting and Virtual Events Platform
products.description: A cloud-based platform for live and on-demand streaming of earnings calls, webinars, and virtual or hybrid events, supporting event creation, production, and delivery for audiences of all sizes, integrated with other communication tools.

products.name: Professional Conference and Events Software
products.description: A subscription-based, cloud and mobile software for investor conference organizers, enabling registration, scheduling, event promotion, sponsorship management, and integration with press release, media room, and webcasting services.

products.name: Investor Relations Websites and Content Network
products.description: A digital solution for designing, hosting, and managing investor relations sections of corporate websites, integrating news, stock, regulatory, and governance data feeds, with ADA/AODA compliance and seamless connection to other communication tools.

products.name: Incident Hotline (Whistleblower Hotline)
products.description: A secure, digital incident reporting and workflow management system supporting corporate governance, offered as an add-on within the subscription platform and subsidized for NYSE-listed companies.

products.name: VeeaONE Edge-Cloud Platform
products.description: A full-stack, cloud-native edge-to-cloud computing and communications platform that provides virtualized data center capabilities, edge computing, edge AI, and cloud-managed applications and services. Delivered as a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS), it is hardware-agnostic and supports both VeeaHub and third-party devices, enabling secure, scalable, and resilient private networks for enterprises and service providers.

products.name: VeeaHub Edge Devices
products.description: A family of highly integrated, all-in-one edge devices that combine a Linux server, virtualized software environment, Wi-Fi access point, mesh router, firewall, IoT gateway, NVMe storage, and 4G/5G modules. These devices are available in multiple form factors for indoor and outdoor coverage and are managed locally or via the cloud, serving as the hardware foundation for edge computing and networking solutions.

products.name: SecureConnect Service Platform
products.description: An all-in-one, subscription-based managed service platform for service providers to deliver broadband connectivity (wired/5G), enterprise-grade cybersecurity, IoT gateway services, and AI-enabled applications to SMB/SME customers. Delivered via compact VeeaHub devices, it features cloud-based management, zero-touch provisioning, and value-added edge services with monthly recurring revenue.

products.name: AirLynx Service Platform
products.description: A turnkey, subscription-based managed Wi-Fi and IoT connectivity service platform for delivering broadband and digital services to locations lacking cellular coverage or underserved communities. It extends internet connectivity via mesh networks using VeeaHub and third-party devices, supporting value-added edge applications such as tele-education, tele-health, smart farming, and public safety, with cloud-based management and flexible billing models.

products.name: MetaLynx Service Platform
products.description: An AI-powered smart edge platform that integrates SecureConnect, AirLynx, and VeeaONE IoT capabilities to deliver industry-specific edge computing and Edge AI solutions. It supports applications for smart buildings, energy management, precision agriculture, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and more, leveraging containerized applications, IoT gateways, and edge analytics for real-time, mission-critical use cases.

products.name: Edge AI and AI-Driven Cybersecurity Solutions
products.description: AI-enabled applications and services delivered at the edge, including AI-driven cybersecurity for data-at-rest and data-in-motion, computer vision, predictive maintenance, and multimodal AI agents. These solutions are integrated into the VeeaONE platform and edge devices, providing real-time analytics, threat detection, and automation for various industries.

products.name: IoT Connectivity and Management Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive IoT gateway and management solutions, including support for Bluetooth, Zigbee, Thread, Matter, and integrated LoRaWAN gateways. These enable large-scale, low-power, wide-area IoT deployments for smart buildings, agriculture, utilities, and industrial IoT, with edge processing and cloud/local management.

products.name: Building and Energy Management Solutions (Niagara BMS)
products.description: Containerized Honeywell Niagara 4 Building Management System (BMS) software, ported to VeeaHub devices, for process automation, energy management, and smart building applications. Delivered as part of the VeeaONE platform, it enables building owners and property managers to manage automation, lighting, energy, and predictive maintenance at the edge.

products.name: AI-Powered Security Screening Solutions
products.description: Integrated hardware and software systems (including Evolv Express and Evolv eXpedite) that use proprietary sensors and AI algorithms to screen people and bags for weapons and threats at venue entry points. Delivered via a Security-as-a-Service subscription model, requiring both physical equipment and connected software.

products.name: Cloud-Based Security Analytics (Evolv Insights)
products.description: A cloud-based analytics application that provides operational visibility, actionable analytics, and automated reports on system performance, visitor flow, and security events, enabling customers to optimize security operations and staffing. Delivered digitally as part of the subscription service.

products.name: Onsite Support and Repair Services
products.description: Comprehensive onsite support and repair services for the full term of the subscription, ensuring customer equipment operates as designed. Delivered through in-person human labor as part of the bundled Security-as-a-Service offering.

products.name: Correspondent Mortgage Loan Production and Sales
products.description: Purchasing newly originated residential mortgage loans (including Agency-eligible, jumbo, and non-qualified loans) from approved mortgage originators, pooling and reselling them to government-sponsored enterprises (GSEs), banks, or other investors, or securitizing them into mortgage-backed securities. This is a capital-intensive, transaction-driven business requiring financial structuring and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSRs)
products.description: Acquiring and holding mortgage servicing rights, which entitle the company to service mortgage loans (collect payments, manage escrow, handle defaults) for a fee. The servicing is performed by an affiliated servicer, but the MSRs are owned as investment assets. This business is capital-intensive and highly regulated.

products.name: Credit Risk Transfer (CRT) Arrangements
products.description: Investing in and structuring credit risk transfer arrangements that absorb credit losses on certain mortgage loans, including CRT derivatives, strips, and securities. These are financial products requiring risk modeling, structuring, and ongoing management.

products.name: Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS) Investments
products.description: Investing in a range of mortgage-backed securities, including Agency and non-Agency MBS, senior and subordinate tranches, interest-only (IO) and principal-only (PO) strips, and floating rate collateralized mortgage obligations (CMOs). This is a capital markets activity involving the purchase, holding, and sale of structured mortgage securities.

products.name: Subordinate and Credit-Linked Mortgage-Backed Securities
products.description: Investing in subordinate and credit-linked mortgage-backed securities, often retained from the company's own securitizations or purchased from others. These securities absorb first losses and require specialized risk management and structuring expertise.

products.name: Distressed Loan and Real Estate Owned (REO) Investments
products.description: Investing in distressed residential mortgage loans and real estate acquired through foreclosure or settlement. This involves asset management, workout, and disposition activities, often requiring specialized servicing and legal expertise.

products.name: Home Equity Lines of Credit (HELOCs)
products.description: Investing in or acquiring home equity lines of credit, either as whole loans or as part of structured pools. This is a smaller, ancillary business line relative to the company's core mortgage activities.

products.name: Civil Infrastructure Construction Services
products.description: Construction and rehabilitation of large-scale civil infrastructure projects such as highways, bridges, tunnels, mass-transit systems, military and government facilities, and water management and wastewater treatment facilities. These services require significant physical construction, engineering expertise, and are delivered through general contracting, design-build, and public-private partnership models.

products.name: Building Construction Services
products.description: General contracting, design-build, and construction management services for large, complex building projects including hospitality and gaming, healthcare, commercial offices, government, education, correctional facilities, biotech, pharmaceutical, industrial, and technology buildings. Delivery involves in-person labor, project management, and coordination of advanced systems and fast-track schedules.

products.name: Specialty Contracting Services (Electrical, Mechanical, Plumbing, HVAC, Fire Protection)
products.description: Design, installation, and maintenance of electrical, mechanical, plumbing, HVAC, and fire protection systems for civil and building construction projects. These services are provided both as part of integrated projects and as standalone offerings to public and private sector clients, requiring skilled trades and technical expertise.

products.name: Oral Biologic Therapeutics via RaniPill Capsule
products.description: A pipeline of orally administered biologic drugs (antibodies, proteins, peptides) delivered using the proprietary RaniPill capsule platform, which enables high-bioavailability delivery of injectable biologics in oral form. Each product candidate consists of a specific biologic formulated within the RaniPill capsule, manufactured through a combination of in-house and partner-supplied biologics, and delivered as a combination product regulated as a drug-device combination.

products.name: RaniPill Capsule Oral Drug Delivery Platform (Partnered Use)
products.description: A proprietary, drug-agnostic oral delivery platform (RaniPill capsule) licensed or partnered with third-party biopharmaceutical companies to enable oral delivery of their biologics and drugs. Delivered as a device or combination product, with Rani providing technology transfer, regulatory support, and manufacturing for partners' molecules.

products.name: Specialty Care Management Services
products.description: An integrated solution that manages specialty care for conditions such as oncology, cardiology, and musculoskeletal disorders, using proprietary technology, evidence-based clinical pathways, and provider network management. Delivered through a combination of technology platforms, clinical expertise, and direct provider engagement.

products.name: Administrative Services for Health Plans
products.description: A suite of administrative and operational services for health plans and providers, including third-party administration, enrollment and billing, medical and utilization management, provider network contracting, risk management, analytics, and reporting. Delivered via a proprietary digital platform and supported by specialized staff.

products.name: Pharmacy Benefit Management Services
products.description: Integrated pharmacy benefit management (PBM) services that support the prescription drug component of health plans, focusing on cost reduction through generic utilization, provider management, and utilization management. Delivered by a dedicated PBM team and integrated with care delivery models.

products.name: Value-Based Care Technology Platforms (Identifi® and CareProTM)
products.description: Proprietary cloud-based technology platforms that aggregate and analyze healthcare data, manage care workflows, provide clinical decision support, and enable value-based care models for payers and providers. Delivered as software-as-a-service with configurable applications and EMR integration.

products.name: Live Online Tutoring and Classes
products.description: A digital platform providing live, online one-on-one and group instruction across thousands of subjects, delivered by vetted human experts using interactive technology tools such as two-way video and collaborative workspaces. Accessible via subscription or direct purchase for learners of all ages, including K-12, college, and professionals.

products.name: Institutional Learning Solutions (Varsity Tutors for Schools)
products.description: A suite of online learning products for educational institutions, including high-dosage tutoring, 24/7 chat-based tutoring, essay review, live and recorded classes, self-study tools, and adaptive assessments, delivered via a unified digital platform to entire student populations.

products.name: Learning Memberships (Subscription Access)
products.description: An all-access subscription product providing learners with ongoing access to one-on-one instruction, live and recorded classes, self-study tools, college and career readiness resources, and adaptive assessments across subjects and formats, delivered digitally.

products.name: Self-Study Tools and Adaptive Assessments
products.description: Digital self-study resources and adaptive diagnostic assessments available through the platform, enabling learners to practice, review, and assess their knowledge independently across a wide range of subjects.

products.name: Test Preparation Services
products.description: Online live and self-paced test preparation for standardized exams (e.g., SAT, ACT) and professional certifications, delivered through classes, tutoring, and digital resources.
